content.title: U.S. Treasury Yields Rise After BOJ Rate Hike
content.summary: U.S. Treasury yields rose across maturities in early trade, after the Bank of Japan raised rates by 25 bps to a three-decade high of 0.75%. Investors might also reassess the big drop in U.S. November inflation, as it might have to do with data challenges caused by the government shutdown, rather than with changes in the economy.

content.title: U.S. Treasury Yields Rise, Thursday's Inflation Data Awaited
content.summary: U.S. Treasury yields were rising across maturities in midday European trade, with Thursday's U.S. inflation data being the next key yardstick. The data are expected to show broadly stable price pressure though an upside surprise could lift the dollar and Treasury yields, said Naga's Frank Walbaum in a note.

content.title: U.S. Treasury Yields Rise, But Remain in Recent Range
content.summary: U.S. Treasury yields were rising in Asian afternoon trade, reversing Tuesday's falls prompted by U.S. data.  President Donald Trump's directive to blockade Venezuelan oil tankers has also lifted yields somewhat overnight, with both U.S.  Treasury yields and Bund futures are back at levels seen before Tuesday's payrolls numbers, Danske Bank's Jens Peter Sorensen said in a note.
